Earlier, Walmart officially announced that after more than ten years of delay, it will finally begin to roll out the Apple Pay service.

When will the Walmart store near you support Apple Pay? I have obtained the complete rollout schedule with all relevant information……

Walmart Apple Pay Rollout Schedule

In today's announcement, Walmart stated that Apple Pay and broader contactless payment support will be rolled out starting next week and will be officially launched across all U.S. stores by the end of this year.

According to an internal memo obtained by 9to5Mac that Walmart sent to store management today, the retailer provided more detailed phased rollout specifics. The company currently plans to roll out state by state. Should any issues arise during the rollout, these dates may change; below is the current schedule:

States Tap to Pay Launch Arkansas Aug. 24–31 California, Washington, Oregon, Nevada, Idaho, Alaska, Hawaii Sept. 10 Kansas, Louisiana, Nebraska, Oklahoma Sept. 14 Texas Sept. 17 Arizona, Utah, Colorado, New Mexico, South Dakota, Montana, North Dakota, Wyoming Sept. 21 Illinois, Ohio, Wisconsin, Minnesota, Iowa Sept. 24 Tennessee, Indiana, Michigan, Kentucky Sept. 28 Georgia, Alabama, Mississippi Oct. 1 Florida Oct. 5 North Carolina, Virginia, South Carolina, West Virginia, Puerto Rico Oct. 8 Pennsylvania, New York, New Jersey, Massachusetts, Maryland, Connecticut, New Hampshire, Maine, Delaware, Rhode Island, Vermont, District of Columbia Oct. 12

Missouri currently does not appear on Walmart's schedule, for reasons unknown.

Walmart also listed in the memo all the contactless payment methods that will be supported:

  • Contactless-enabled credit and debit cards
  • Digital wallets, including Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Samsung Pay
  • Payment-capable smartwatches and wearable devices
  • Supported contactless EBT cards

Walmart supporting Apple Pay is long overdue. Will this change where you choose to shop? Feel free to let us know in the comments.
